subject: Can I have my .cpp file in another folder and call it without setwd?

messages.author: 6667ef04b386b9ec
messages.subject: Can I have my .cpp file in another folder and call it without setwd?
parts:
Hi There!

I tried to call a .cpp in another directory from my script.R file, but it did not work. See:

# First and Desired Attempt
model <- "02_poisson_multivariate" #1st try
path_cpp <- "/home/guilherme/Google Drive/Mestrado/dissertacao/TMB/MultivariateModels/Servidor/"
compile(paste0(path_cpp, model, ".cpp"), flags = "-O0 -ggdb")

Output
Note: Using Makevars in /home/guilherme/.R/Makevars
make: Circular /home/guilherme/Google <- /home/guilherme/Google dependency dropped
make: *** No rule to make target 'Drive/Mestrado/dissertacao/TMB/MultivariateModels/Servidor/02_poisson_multivariate.o', needed by '/home/guilherme/Google'.  Stop
Error in compile(paste0(path_cpp, model, ".cpp"), flags = "-O0 -ggdb") :
  Compilation failed

# Second Attempt:
model <- "02_poisson_multivariate" #1st try
path_cpp <- "/home/guilherme/Google Drive/Mestrado/dissertacao/TMB/MultivariateModels/Servidor/"
setwd(path_cpp)
compile(paste0(model, ".cpp"), flags = "-O0 -ggdb")
dyn.load(dynlib(model))

It works. Although, I don't like this approach.

What is the meaning of that error? Is there a way to correct it?

Thanks
